column1: # Transposon-insertion-sequencing fitness indices for Salmonella enterica
# serovar Typhimurium ST313 strain D23580, from Canals R, Hammarlof DL,
# Kroger C, Owen SV, Fong WY, Lacharme-Lora L, Zhu X, Wenner N, Carden SE,
# Honeycutt J, Monack DM, Kingsley RA, Brownridge P, Chaudhuri RR, Rowe WPM,
# Predeus AV, Hokamp K, Gordon MA, Hinton JCD (2019) Adding function to the
# genome of African Salmonella Typhimurium ST313 strain D23580.  The fitness
# landscape of the African Salmonella Typhimurium ST313 strain D23580 reveals
# unique properties of the pBT1 plasmid.  PLoS Pathogens 15:e1007948.
# WHAT THE INDEX IS.  For each gene the published S2 Table gives an insertion
# index (transposon insertion sites per base of gene length) in the input
# library and in each output.  The index below is output/input, divided by the
# genome-wide median of that ratio so that a NEUTRAL gene scores 1.0 and a gene
# whose mutants are depleted scores below 1.0.  The raw medians were LB 0.8145,
# InSPI2 0.8562, macrophage 0.8500.  A gene is called to carry an in vitro
# fitness cost at <= 0.2, the same five-fold depletion Khatiwara 2012 uses.
# The two indices are NOT the same quantity -- Khatiwara's is a ratio of read
# abundance, this one a ratio of insertion-site density -- and the shared
# cutoff is conservative here: on the 106 genes both screens measure they
# correlate at Spearman rho 0.518 (P = 1.3e-8) and Khatiwara's cost genes sit
# at a median of 0.554 against 0.995 for its neutral genes (Mann-Whitney
# P = 6.9e-6), yet only 4 of 26 cross <= 0.2 in both (odds ratio 7.09, Fisher
# P = 0.031).  The agreement is in rank and direction, not in absolute value.
# The cutoff was NOT retuned to make more genes cross it; 50 genes reach it
# genome-wide, and that conservatism is declared rather than corrected.
# WHY THE PUBLISHED BINARY CALL IS NOT USED.  S2 Table also carries a
# three-level call (required / not required / ambiguous).  That call fails the
# virulence control: it marks 17 of 41 SPI-2 genes "required" for growth in LB,
# including ssaH and ssaS at one recovered insertion each and ssaJ and ssaG at
# two.  The input library itself already calls 16 of 41 SPI-2 genes required,
# so the deficit is sparse transposon coverage of the SPI-2 region in this
# library, not a growth requirement -- ssaV mutants grow normally in rich
# medium.  Dividing by the input normalises that away: on the index below the
# SPI-2 median is 0.862 in LB and 0 of 36 SPI-2 genes reach <= 0.2, while in
# the macrophage arm the SPI-2 median falls to 0.495 with 20 of 36 at <= 0.5.
# Only the normalised index is used; the published call is carried in
# `published_call_lb` for audit and is never read by the pipeline.
# WHICH ARM GATES.  LB at 37 C is the OPTIMAL-GROWTH control and the only
# column used to call an in vitro fitness cost.  InSPI2 is a SPI-2-inducing
# minimal medium -- low magnesium, low phosphate, acidic -- which is a
# host-mimicking stressor, and the macrophage arm is a host condition; both are
# carried for audit only.  The reason is visible in the file: aroA scores 1.18
# in LB and 0.05 in InSPI2, and rfaH scores 1.55 and 0.14.  Their cost in
# minimal medium IS their mechanism of attenuation in the host, because the
# host is poor in aromatic amino acids.  Gating on InSPI2 would subtract the
# host's own selective pressures from a definition of host specificity and
# would discard the best-validated attenuated Salmonella mutants in the
# COVERAGE.  Every gene in the genome is assayed and reported, not only the
# genes that cross a threshold, so absence of a gene from this file is
# informative in a way that absence from Khatiwara Table S3 is not.  Genes with
# fewer than three recovered insertions in the input are omitted because the
# ratio is not estimable; 3,998 SL1344 genes receive a value.
# STRAIN TRANSFER.  The screen is in D23580, sequence type 313 lineage 2
# (STMMW_ locus tags); the reference genome here is SL1344, sequence type 19.
# Values were moved one-to-one by identical protein sequence (3,459), >= 90%
# identity after length-bucketed seeding (400), or the paper's own gene symbol
# where it is unique in SL1344 (139); `orthologue_method` records which
# applied, and no SL1344 gene receives two values.  The lineages are not
# interchangeable: the paper's own Fig 3A finds 101 required genes unique to
# D23580 against 388 shared with ST19 strains.  Treat a single-arm value near
# the threshold as weaker evidence than one confirmed by the native ATCC 14028
